assets.name: 01-island-garden
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, ultra-photorealistic cinematic landscape architectural visualization. Create a polished large LANDSCAPE concept image for expanding the existing Pait Island pet sanctuary with a farm and personal garden. Reference image is the existing island architecture and layout, not a target of pixel preservation. Keep its recognizable iron-and-glass conservatory, silver birches and cedars, central shallow river, stone arch footbridge, weathered limestone cliff base and delicate railings. Expand the usable island area organically to roughly twice the original, irregular natural terraced footprint rather than a perfect disk. The original sanctuary occupies the back-right; add a sunny horticultural terrace on the front-left connected by a wide safe stone path. Exactly six modest raised planting beds laid out as two rows of three, some with realistic young crops and others flowers at different stages. Add two small clearly separated tree nursery beds, a potting workbench with pot sizes and soil, a modest harvested-produce storage cabinet, terracotta and glazed ceramic flowerpots placed decoratively along the path, several newly transplanted saplings with real root collars, and an open grassy pet roaming space. A single realistic small tabby cat provides scale near a flowerpot. Clear unobstructed walkable routes, physical railings near cliff edges, bridge across river, no plant beds blocking the bridge or greenhouse doors. Island floats above a vast cinematic cloud sea and distant mountains. Photoreal believable PBR textures, granular dark soil, leaf venation and translucency, imperfect wood grain, wet stone, fine bark, brass tools, lush but cultivated plant clusters, natural scale. Warm slanting morning light, atmospheric aerial perspective, premium calm dreamlike botanical refuge, realistic not cartoon. Elevated three-quarter view, entire expanded island readable, strong composition, deep natural greens and pale stone, no text, no labels, no watermark, no huge fantasy flowers. This is a design visualization, not a screenshot of an implemented feature.

assets.name: 02-flower-growth
assets.prompt: Create a high-resolution landscape photorealistic botanical 3D ASSET DEVELOPMENT SHEET for a flowering cosmos plant (Cosmos bipinnatus), part of a premium realistic pet-island garden game. Exactly TEN clearly separated numbered panels, arranged two rows of five, read left to right 01–05 then 06–10. Off-white museum studio background, extremely crisp realistic PBR botanical surfaces and soft neutral daylight. One individual same-species plant per panel, visibly changing biological structure, NOT ten scaled duplicates. Each plant grows from a small dark-earth plug, its entire form fully visible with generous whitespace; larger specimens fit their panel at naturally adjusted framing, not a shared misleading height ruler. Stages: 01 single narrow seed resting in shallow soil depression; 02 germinating seed showing tiny white root in a small cutaway soil plug; 03 emerged cotyledon pair; 04 first finely divided true leaves; 05 several true leaves and a longer stem; 06 branching leafy juvenile with feathery foliage; 07 more branching and tiny distinct flower buds; 08 full closed flower buds with green bracts; 09 first partly opening pink blossom, several unopened buds; 10 mature pink cosmos in full bloom with natural asymmetric branches, yellow disk centers, overlapping thin pink ray petals, new buds and healthy fine foliage. Mark each panel only with clear small numerals 01 through 10, exactly one numeral per panel, no other text. Same coherent leaf morphology throughout; realistic stem diameter, believable internodes, restrained natural variation, subtle leaf translucency and petal veins, soil crumbs and tiny root fibers. No cartoon, no low poly, no repeated identical silhouettes, no fantasy leaves, no mature flowers on seedlings. This is a reference concept sheet for ten distinct future Blender growth models, not proof of completed 3D models.

assets.name: 03-food-growth
assets.prompt: Create a high-resolution landscape photorealistic botanical 3D ASSET DEVELOPMENT SHEET for a compact trailing pumpkin plant, part of a premium realistic pet-island garden game. Exactly TEN clearly separated numbered panels in two rows of five, 01–05 above 06–10. Soft off-white seamless studio background with dark-earth patches, natural soft daylight and precise PBR botanical details. One coherent plant life stage in each panel, whole silhouette visible. Do NOT simply scale one plant; show genuinely different leaves, branch structure, tendrils, blossoms, fruit attachment and maturity. 01 one pale pumpkin seed in a shallow soil pocket; 02 germinating seed with short root visible in cutaway soil plug; 03 two thick oval cotyledons above soil; 04 first lobed true leaf and cotyledons; 05 three to four lobed true leaves with visibly rough veins; 06 short spreading juvenile vine with several petioles and curling tendrils; 07 branching compact vine bearing unopened flower buds; 08 open yellow funnel-shaped blossom with ridged green ovary at its base and another closed bud; 09 one small immature green pumpkin visibly attached to a stout peduncle, expanded leaves and tendrils; 10 one ripe modest orange ribbed pumpkin with a slightly corky attached stem, healthy mature vine plus a few naturally aging basal leaves. All stages belong to the same species and same garden-scale cultivar, no upright tomato-like trunk, no floating fruit, no random vegetables. Detailed leaf veins, subtle soft leaf/stem hairs, leaf serration, five-lobed yellow corolla, believable fruit ribs and soil granularity. Slightly elevated three-quarter framing consistently from one direction, adaptive framing for large sprawling stages so no plant is cropped. Only label panels with 01 through 10, no other words, no watermark. Reference images for ten distinct future Blender growth assets; strictly realistic, not stylized toy plants.

assets.name: 04-tree-growth
assets.prompt: Create a high-resolution landscape photorealistic botanical 3D ASSET DEVELOPMENT SHEET for a birch sapling (Betula), for a premium realistic cloud-island garden game. Exactly TEN separate numbered specimens, two rows of five, left-to-right 01–05 then 06–10, on soft off-white neutral studio background. Gentle daylight, exquisite authentic PBR materials. Show a biologically plausible SEED-TO-TRANSPLANTABLE-SAPLING development sequence, not a giant mature forest tree and not ten scaled copies. 01 tiny birch seeds on dark soil in a nursery cell; 02 germinating seed and delicate root in a small cutaway soil plug; 03 emerging paired seed leaves; 04 first small true leaves with serrated edges; 05 several young triangular-to-ovate leaves with pinnate veins along a slender green stem; 06 taller juvenile, alternating leaves and initial lateral buds; 07 first two lateral branches, subtle stem lignification; 08 branched sapling with brown young bark, slender twigs and a small fibrous root ball; 09 fuller asymmetric young crown with several woody lateral branches and visible fine-root network on an exposed soil root ball; 10 transplant-ready young birch with graceful trunk taper, brown-to-pale young bark with subtle lenticels, distinct branching hierarchy and individual leaves, burlap-wrapped root ball loosely tied below the root collar. Every plant completely visible, separate silhouette and adequate whitespace; adapt camera framing per panel, no height ruler suggesting equal size. Keep all juvenile bark mostly natural tan/brown, never put thick peeling white adult bark on tiny seedlings. Realistic leaf attachment, leaf translucency, fine serrations, moist soil, root collar and branching. Only numerals 01 through 10, one per panel, no captions or watermark. This is a detailed concept reference for at least ten distinct Blender growth states, not finished 3D asset evidence.
